job.name: Afterschool Nanny in Newport Coast (6YO & 11YO)
job.description:
Afterschool Nanny in Newport Coast (6YO & 11YO)


Children: 6-year-old and 11-year-old (two boys: one born in December 2019 and the other born in July 2015)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 2:30 PM–6:30 PM (20 hours/week)

Pay: $18–$20/hour base pay

Location: Newport Coast, CA 92657

Commitment: 12+ months preferred


Hello,


Are you smart, capable, and always ready for an adventure? If so, this may be the perfect childcare opportunity for you!


At Jovie Newport Beach, we believe in the magic of childhood and are looking for caregivers who share our passion for helping children learn, grow, and thrive. If babysitting feels more like play than work and you naturally gravitate toward engaging with kids, we’d love to meet you.


For over 20 years, Jovie (formerly College Nannies + Sitters) has been a trusted childcare provider serving families across the United States. Our mission is simple: Building Stronger Families. We provide our caregivers with support, flexibility, and opportunities to make a meaningful difference in the lives of local families.


Your Role:

A warm and welcoming family in Newport Coast is seeking a dependable, mature, and engaging afterschool nanny for their two children, ages 6 and 11. The children are kind, well-behaved, follow instructions well, and get along with one another.


The family is looking for someone who can provide a consistent and positive presence in the children’s lives while helping them transition smoothly from school into their afternoon routines. The ideal nanny will be calm, loving, professional, and confident taking the lead while maintaining a warm relationship with the children.


The family lives in a spacious home with a pool, playroom, movie room, and dedicated spaces for schoolwork. The household also includes a live-in maid and occasional instructors, including tutors and music teachers. Mom and Dad are described as supportive and gentle and are available to provide guidance when needed.
